assignments.scope: Craft Project identity, purpose, scope, goals, evidence coordination, and lifecycle decisions; excludes Product meaning, Method meaning, Definition admission, identity-graph membership, implementation, publication, and deployment.

Binding and applying the admitted Craft Method within an exact Product or Project scope; excludes changing Method Definition meaning, Product or Project ownership, execution authority, conformance, publication, and deployment.

Craft Goal outcome, rationale, success conditions, evidence requirements, and lifecycle decision; excludes Project coordination, Product or Method meaning, execution authority, and treating validation as achievement.
Exact typed relation kind, endpoints, membership, and graph consistency; excludes endpoint meaning or admission, ownership inference, context inference, implementation, publication, and deployment.

separation_rule: A shared principal does not merge roles. Each assignment retains an independent scope, decision record, evidence obligation, and claim ceiling; no owner, identity, relation, lifecycle, or authority field is inferred from another.
claim_ceiling: This candidate preserves the admitted Craft Product owner and proposes four additional independently scoped bindings. It does not activate any role or admit any artifact.
